key_insight: Pulsating detonation jets produced at least twice the coating-surface heat flux of conventional jets while also hardening capillary-porous coatings.
engineering_relevance: Detonation spraying offers a route to forming porous coatings on metallic surfaces with higher critical heat loads and controllable limiting thermal regimes.
method: Investigated 26 combustion chambers and nozzles to select a spraying device.
Developed a powder-and-thermite feed scheme using fuel-rich operation (α < 1) with afterburning at the coating surface.
Modeled detonation-wave interaction with the coating and determined coating temperature.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports at least twofold heat-flux enhancement, approximately 200 Hz surface-pressure oscillations, and seven-zone spinning detonation.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify coating durability or provide operating limits for managing the increased heat flux and pressure oscillations.
paper_title: INVESTIGATION OF THERMAL PROCESSES DURING DETONATION SPRAYING OF CAPILLARYPOROUS COATINGS
